name: Corner Woodworks
old_description: Welcome to the home of Corner Woodworks! We build to order, build to suit, and also design in collaboration with you for your space. For our furniture, custom cabinets, and wood countertops we use genuine solid hardwoods combined with modern day joinery and silky smooth hand rubbed finishes that we guarantee to bead water.
about:
Corner Woodworks operates from Manchester, Maryland. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The shop produces custom furniture, cabinetry, millwork, and butcher-block countertops using solid hardwoods and modern joinery techniques. Finishes are hand-rubbed oils that penetrate the wood rather than forming a surface film like polyurethane or conversion varnish. The company states it never uses veneers over fiberboard, and all items are made in the United States.

Corner Woodworks serves residential and commercial clients seeking made-to-order woodwork for kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The firm collaborates on design with each customer, building to order or to suit specific spatial requirements.

The company emphasizes its finish system as a key differentiator: the oil-based treatment becomes part of the wood, providing a flexible, durable surface that accentuates natural grain and feels smooth to the touch. This approach, combined with a strict solid-wood policy, is presented as the reason customers choose the shop.
